name: clarify_desks
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Can I order desks from DeskCo? I don't have the total price yet and have not committed to anything. What should I do next?
ground_truth: Missing decision fact: total proposed commitment for the desk order. Next action: ask for that total, without listing the alternative quotation/approver routes. A brief explanation and reminder not to commit before required approvals are allowed. Ordinary desks do not require software security or training approval. Source: [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_designcloud_scope
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have one quotation and line-manager approval for a $1,200 DesignCloud Studio subscription. We haven't described the intended use or data yet. What is left before we buy?
ground_truth: Missing decision facts: intended use and data scope. Ask what the team will use DesignCloud Studio for and what data it will upload or process. Do not assume the public-assets clearance applies or list hypothetical clearance/approval routes. Quotation and spending approval are complete; do not request them again. Sources: [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: clarify_nova_cost_programme
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We want Nova Learning Portal licences for employee training. We will use only public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. I haven't provided the total cost or the programme, and no quotation or individual approval has been obtained. What next?
ground_truth: Missing decision facts: total proposed commitment and programme/employee group. Ask for both, without listing the normal and graduate spending routes. The stated use is covered by the current portal security clearance. Training Lead suitability approval remains independently required; mentioning it is allowed but does not replace asking for the missing facts. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:training-suitability] [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance].

name: clarify_designcloud_cost_scope
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We want to subscribe to DesignCloud Studio. Neither the total commitment nor the intended use and data scope has been decided. We have no approvals. What information do you need next?
ground_truth: Ask for the total proposed commitment AND intended use/data scope. Both are needed to determine the complete process. Do not assume a spending route or that the public-content clearance applies, and do not enumerate conditional routes while these facts are absent. A general no-commitment reminder is allowed. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance].

name: remaining_hardware_approval
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our ordinary laptop order totals $8,000 with no separately purchased software service. We already have two supplier quotations, but no spending approval. What must happen before ordering?
ground_truth: Obtain Category Manager spending approval before commitment. The total exceeds $5,000 and the two required quotations are already obtained. Do not require new quotations, line-manager approval, software security review or training approval. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review].

name: remaining_designcloud_security
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have one quotation and line-manager approval for a $1,200 DesignCloud Studio subscription. We will upload customer campaign files and have no separate Security Team clearance. What is left before we can buy?
ground_truth: Obtain Security Team clearance for customer-file use before purchase. The September customer-file pilot expired and the current public-assets notice excludes customer files. The quotation and line-manager approval are complete and must not be requested again. Sources: [policy:software-review] [notice:designcloud-customer-pilot] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:purchasing].

name: remaining_nova_training
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our $6,200 Nova Learning Portal purchase is for leadership training using public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records only. We have two supplier quotations and Category Manager approval, but not Training Lead approval. What next?
ground_truth: Obtain Training Lead suitability approval before commitment. Normal spending requirements are already complete; the graduate exception does not apply to leadership training. The current portal security clearance does cover this stated leadership use. Do not demand additional quotations, spending approval or fresh security review. Sources: [policy:training-suitability] [policy:purchasing] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [notice:nova-graduate-exception].

name: remaining_brightpath_expired
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We plan a $6,250 BrightPath in-person Leadership Essentials workshop for new people managers, with no online service. We have one quotation, Head of Learning approval and Training Lead approval, but no Category Manager approval. What remains before booking?
ground_truth: Obtain a second supplier quotation and Category Manager spending approval before commitment. The BrightPath exception expired September 30, so Head of Learning approval is not the applicable spending approval on October 5. Training Lead approval is complete and no software security review is required for this in-person-only course. Sources: [notice:brightpath-leadership-exception] [policy:purchasing] [policy:training-suitability] [policy:software-review].

name: exception_nova_spending
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We need $6,250 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme, using public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records only. We have one quotation and Training Lead approval, but no spending approval. What next?
ground_truth: Obtain Head of Learning spending approval before commitment and by November 4, 2026 inclusive. The graduate exception replaces the normal spending route regardless of amount. The quotation and Training Lead approval are complete; the current portal security clearance covers the stated use. Do not request a second quotation, Category Manager approval or fresh security review. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: exception_nova_suitability
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. For a $2,500 Nova Learning Portal purchase for the new graduate programme, we have one quotation and Head of Learning spending approval. We will use public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records only. Training Lead approval is not obtained. What remains?
ground_truth: Obtain Training Lead suitability approval before commitment. The valid graduate exception makes the existing quotation and Head of Learning approval the completed spending route; line-manager approval is not additionally required. Current portal security clearance covers the use. The exception does not waive training suitability approval. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: exception_nova_sensitive_data
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our $7,400 Nova Learning Portal purchase is for the new graduate programme. We have one quotation, Head of Learning spending approval and Training Lead approval. We want to upload employee performance reviews as well as names and work emails. No separate security review has been done. What next?
ground_truth: Obtain Security Team clearance for employee performance-review uploads before purchase. The current portal notice excludes those documents. The graduate exception does not waive security review. The quotation, spending approval and training suitability approval are already complete and must not be requested again. Sources: [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:software-review] [notice:nova-graduate-exception].

name: exception_nova_quote_and_approval
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We want $5,000 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme using public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records only. Training Lead approval is complete, but we have no supplier quotation or spending approval. What must we obtain?
ground_truth: Obtain one supplier quotation and Head of Learning spending approval before commitment, with that approval by November 4, 2026 inclusive. The valid graduate exception applies even at $5,000; do not substitute or add line-manager approval. Training suitability is complete and the current portal security clearance applies. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].

name: ready_keyboards
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have one supplier quotation and line-manager approval for a $1,200 purchase of ordinary office keyboards. Is another approval required before we order?
ground_truth: No additional requirement is identified under the supplied policies: the one quotation and line-manager spending approval satisfy the route for $1,200. Ordinary keyboards do not need software security review or training approval. Recognise readiness without personally granting approval or inventing a further blocker. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review].

name: ready_hardware_boundary
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. Our ordinary monitor order totals exactly $5,000. We already have one supplier quotation and line-manager approval. No software service is included. What remains before ordering?
ground_truth: Nothing further is required under the supplied policies. Exactly $5,000 is in the one-quotation plus line-manager route, both complete. Do not demand two quotations, Category Manager approval or Security Team review. The agent may describe readiness but cannot grant approval itself. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [policy:software-review].

name: ready_designcloud_public
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have one quotation and line-manager approval for $4,800 of DesignCloud Studio. We will use only public templates, already-public marketing assets and business-email login, with no other data. Can we proceed under these policies?
ground_truth: Yes, no outstanding requirement is identified under the supplied policies. The quotation and line-manager approval complete spending requirements, and the October 1-December 31 inclusive public-assets security clearance covers the precise use. Do not require another security review or ask again about data scope. Advising readiness is allowed; claiming to grant approval is not. Sources: [policy:purchasing] [notice:designcloud-public-clearance] [policy:software-review].

name: ready_nova_graduates
query: Decision date: 2026-10-05. We have one quotation, Head of Learning spending approval and Training Lead approval for $9,800 of Nova Learning Portal licences for the new graduate programme. Use is limited to public courses, employee names, work emails and completion records. Is there any outstanding requirement before purchase?
ground_truth: No outstanding requirement is identified. The currently valid graduate exception permits one quotation and Head of Learning spending approval regardless of amount, both obtained. Training Lead approval is obtained and current portal security clearance covers this use. Do not require a second quotation, Category Manager approval or fresh security review. Sources: [notice:nova-graduate-exception] [notice:nova-portal-clearance] [policy:training-suitability].
